verses.text: On the first day of the month, in the eleventh year, the LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, Tyre has said about Jerusalem, 'Aha! The gateway to the nations is broken, and its doors have swung open to me. Now that she lies in ruins, I will get rich.'
So this is what the Lord GOD says: 'Look, I am against you, Tyre. I will bring many nations against you, like the sea when it throws up its waves.
They will destroy the walls of Tyre and tear down her towers. I will scrape away her soil and make her a bare rock.
Out in the sea she will become a place to spread fishing nets, for I have spoken, says the Lord GOD. She will become loot for the nations.
The people in her villages on the mainland will be killed by the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'
For this is what the Lord GOD says: 'From the north I am going to bring against Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, with horses and chariots, riders and a great army.
He will kill the people in your villages on the mainland with the sword. He will set up siege walls against you, build a ramp up to your walls, and raise his shields against you.
He will pound your walls with battering rams and tear down your towers with his weapons.

His horses will be so many that you will be covered with their dust. Your walls will shake at the noise of the war horses, wagons, and chariots when he enters your gates, as men enter a city whose walls have been broken through.
The hooves of his horses will trample all your streets. He will kill your people with the sword, and your strong pillars will fall to the ground.
They will rob you of your wealth and loot your goods. They will tear down your walls and destroy your fine houses. They will throw your stones, timber, and rubble into the sea.
I will put an end to the noise of your songs. The music of your harps will be heard no more.
I will make you a bare rock, and you will become a place to spread fishing nets. You will never be rebuilt, for I, the LORD, have spoken, says the Lord GOD.'
This is what the Lord GOD says to Tyre: 'Won't the coastlands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan and the killing goes on in you?

Then all the princes of the coast will step down from their thrones. They will take off their robes and their embroidered clothes. Clothed with terror, they will sit on the ground, trembling every moment, shocked at what has happened to you.

Then they will sing a funeral song for you and say: "How you are destroyed, famous city, home of sailors! You were powerful on the sea, you and your people. You spread terror over everyone who lived there.
Now the coastlands tremble on the day of your fall. The islands in the sea are terrified at your end."'
For this is what the Lord GOD says: 'When I make you a ruined city, like cities where no one lives, when I bring the ocean depths over you and its great waters cover you,

then I will bring you down to the pit, to join the people of long ago. I will make you live in the world below, among ancient ruins, with those who go down to the pit. You will never again be lived in or have a place in the land of the living.
I will bring you to a terrible end, and you will be no more. People will look for you, but you will never be found again, says the Lord GOD.'"
